title: 第1章 师弟你再不突破师父赶你下山了第2章 三十年终入搬气
content_zh:
白云派。
白梧山。
白梧山外山连山，诸多山峰依靠白梧山而活，久而久之，形成了白梧山外无数山峰的传说，灵气孕育下，这些山峰都是不错的修炼之地，灵气浓郁的山峰逐渐开辟成洞府。
灵药峰，乃是诸多山峰不起眼的一座山峰。
“师弟，上山三十年了，你还没突破搬气，再不突破，师父可就要赶你下山。”
少女笑吟吟看着忙碌种地的男人，满脸宠溺。
她的声音宛如铜铃，轻盈而动听。
整座山峰因她的存在而变得五彩绚烂，摇曳的花儿绽开了笑脸。
种田的男人举起锄头，连续下了三下锄头。
擦拭额头的汗水，他抬头笑道：“师姐，这句话你已经说了不下三十次了，每个月你都说一次，师父他老人家不会关注我的。”
话语间，带着淡淡的无所谓，也有着一点自信。
似乎，不被人注意反而成为他的开心点。
少女闻言，眨眼，注视着自己的师弟，上山三十年，还是练血修为，乃是白云派里的一朵奇葩。
练血，搬气，纳魂，凝丹。
师弟一直处于第一境界的巅峰，这么多年，没有改变过。
明语有些担心，他这样子真的会被赶下山的。
“你要的灵元液，这一次可要突破搬气了。”
“谢谢师姐。”
许君白笑着接过了一瓶灵元液，这可是好东西，白云派特有的好东西，能够帮助人凝聚灵气，从而进入搬气境界，哪怕是在白云派也是不可多得的好东西。
修为差的人，可没几个买到。

“最后一份灵元液了，再要也没有了，师弟你可要抓紧时间突破搬气，再过两年不突破，到时候哪怕师父不赶你下山，宗门也不会允许你留在山上。”
“师弟，师姐可不想你被赶走。”
许君白闻言，愣了愣。
“师姐。”
“好了，师弟，莫要说话，好好修炼。”
少女举起手，不让许君白说话。
转身，轻盈离去。
山顶。
少女恭敬站在一个中年男人身边。
中年男人乃是白云派白梧峰的峰主，也是许君白的师父，白苍真人。
背负双手的他，目光注视着灵药峰的那个身影，忙碌的身影，似乎丝毫没有察觉到被人注视的感觉。
“明语，灵元液乃是你的修炼资源，都给了你师弟，你怎么办？”
“你已经到了突破的关头，灵元液……”
少女龇牙一笑，丝毫不放在心上。
“师父，弟子心里有数。”
白苍真人被气乐了。
content_en:
Baiyun faction.
Baiwu Mountain.
There are mountains outside Baiwu Mountain, and many peaks rely on Baiwu Mountain for survival. Over time, the legend of countless peaks outside Baiwu Mountain has been formed. Bred by spiritual energy, these peaks are good places for cultivation, and the peaks with rich spiritual energy gradually open up into caves.
Spirit Medicine Peak is an inconspicuous peak among many peaks.
"Junior brother, you have been up the mountain for thirty years and you haven't broken through yet. If you don't break through, Master will drive you down the mountain."
The girl looked at the man busy farming with a smile, her face full of adoration.
Her voice is like a copper bell, light and melodious.
The entire mountain peak became colorful because of her presence, and the swaying flowers bloomed with smiles.
The man farming raised his hoe and hit it three times in succession.
Wiping the sweat from his forehead, he raised his head and smiled: "Sister, you have said this no less than thirty times. You say it once every month. Master will not pay attention to me."
There was a touch of indifference and a little confidence in his words.
It seems that not being noticed has become his happy point.
When the girl heard this, she blinked and looked at her junior brother. He had been practicing blood cultivation for thirty years on the mountain, and he was a strange flower in the Baiyun Sect.
Practice blood, move Qi, absorb soul, and condense elixir.
Junior brother has always been at the peak of the first realm, and it has not changed for so many years.
Mingyu was a little worried that he would really be driven off the mountain like this.
"The spiritual essence liquid you want is going to break through and move the energy this time."
"Thank you, senior sister."
Xu Junbai smiled and took a bottle of Spiritual Essence Liquid. This is a good thing. It is a good thing unique to the Baiyun Sect. It can help people condense spiritual energy and enter the realm of moving Qi. It is a rare good thing even in the Baiyun Sect.
Not many people with poor cultivation can buy it.
"This is the last piece of Spiritual Essence Liquid. I don't want any more. Junior brother, you must seize the time to break through and move your energy. If you don't break through in another two years, then even if the master doesn't drive you down the mountain, the sect will not allow you to stay on the mountain."
"Junior brother, senior sister doesn't want you to be driven away."
Xu Junbai was stunned when he heard this.
"Sister."
"Okay, junior brother, don't talk and practice hard."
The girl raised her hands to prevent Xu Junbai from speaking.
Turn around and leave lightly.
Mountain top.
The girl stood respectfully next to a middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man is the peak master of Baiyun Sect's Baiwu Peak and Xu Junbai's master, Master Bai Cang.
With his hands behind his back, he stared at the figure at Spiritual Medicine Peak. The busy figure seemed not to notice the feeling of being watched at all.
"Mingyu, the Spiritual Essence Liquid is your cultivation resource, and it has been given to your junior brother. What should you do?"
"You have reached the critical moment of breakthrough, Spiritual Essence Liquid..."
The girl bared her teeth and smiled, not caring at all.
"Master, this disciple knows what he is doing."
Master Bai Cang was very angry.
